name: Everline Resort & Spa
positioning: Ski-in/ski-out mountain resort in Olympic Valley at the base of Palisades Tahoe, with a spa, heated outdoor pools and a championship golf course
best_for: Skiers who want ski-in/ski-out access to Palisades Tahoe
Families looking for year-round outdoor activities, pools and suites with kitchenettes
Golfers and spa-goers on a mountain getaway

facts.text: Everline sits in Olympic Valley at the base of Palisades Tahoe, home of the 1960 Winter Olympics.
The resort is inspired by Tahoe's evergreen landscape and the historic railroad line that connected the region.
Rooms and suites have views of the Sierra Nevada, pine forests and meadows.
Accommodations include fireplace suites and penthouses, all with custom furnishings, granite vanities and LED flat-screen TVs.
Fireplace suites have a gas fireplace, a resort kitchenette and a dining area.
The Spa at Everline offers massages, body treatments and facials, with access to the heated Oasis Pool Complex and a fitness center with steam room and sauna.
The resort has outdoor swimming pools that are heated year-round.
Summer options include guided hikes, bike rides, fly-fishing in private ponds and paddleboarding on Lake Tahoe.
Winter activities include cross-country skiing, snowshoeing, sledding, ice skating and broomball, weather permitting.
Complimentary shuttles run daily to Palisades Tahoe and seasonally to Tahoe City.
Six Peaks Grille is the resort's signature steakhouse, with premium cuts, fresh seafood and seasonal accompaniments.
A shopping promenade has boutiques with resort wear, sporting apparel and outdoor gear.

highlights.text: The resort has ski-in/ski-out access to Palisades Tahoe.
The Links at Everline is a championship Robert Trent Jones Jr. golf course at the base of Palisades Tahoe, surrounded by six Sierra peaks.
The Oasis Pool Complex has a heated lap pool, a waterslide and whirlpools.
The resort has a private ice rink and over six miles of Nordic trails.
Penthouses have grand picture windows framing views of Olympic Valley and its surrounding peaks.

considerations.text: Activities are subject to change based on weather conditions, and advance reservations may be required.
Guests must be 18 or over to receive spa services.
WhataHotel notes the remote mountain location requires travel planning.
